title: 船塢檢修與腐蝕量測
subcategoryTitle: 量測、可靠度與數位驗證
summary: 以同點網格、厚度回波和照片追溯船塢檢查，避免以平均厚度掩蓋點蝕。 在船塢影像與厚度地圖室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Trace dry-dock inspection through repeated grids, thickness echoes and photographs without hiding pits in averages. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Dry-dock image/thickness-map studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 同網格厚度變化：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Same-grid thickness changes: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 同網格厚度變化 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Same-grid thickness changes and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船塢檢修與腐蝕量測」的「同網格厚度變化」中，在明示線性假設下，厚度差除時間得到平均減薄率。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：以同點網格、厚度回波和照片追溯船塢檢查，避免以平均厚度掩蓋點蝕。
steps.instructionEn: Within Dry-dock inspection and corrosion measurement, Same-grid thickness changes examines this mechanism: Under an explicit linear assumption, thickness loss over time gives average thinning rate. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Trace dry-dock inspection through repeated grids, thickness echoes and photographs without hiding pits in averages.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：t0=12 mm，t1=11.2 mm，間隔4年。關係式 r=(t0−t1)/Δyears；含單位換算算式 (12-11.2)/4 = 0.2 mm/year。適用條件：平均率不保證未來線性，也不描述點蝕最大深度。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Initial thickness 12 mm, later thickness 11.2 mm and interval 4 years. Relation r=(t0−t1)/Δyears; expression including unit conversion (12-11.2)/4 = 0.2 mm/year. Applicability: Average rate does not guarantee future linearity or describe maximum pit depth.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：不同位置讀值相減可能把厚度空間差當時間腐蝕。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Subtracting different locations confuses spatial variation with time corrosion. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「同網格厚度變化」，比較相同網格位置，報告最小值、平均值與量測不確定度。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Same-grid thickness changes, Compare identical grid points and report minimum, mean and measurement uncertainty. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

knowledge.text: 在「同網格厚度變化」比較基準算式 (12-11.2)/4 與替代算式 (12-10.8)/4。先圈出唯一變動的輸入並預測增減，再計算 0.3 mm/year，與基準 0.2 mm/year 比較。保存輸入、單位、兩個輸出與一項不能外推的結論；只在數位模型或紙上進行。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「船塢檢修與腐蝕量測」的「同網格厚度變化：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「船塢學院：一艘模型的交付」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Same-grid thickness changes: Mechanism and observation” in “Dry-dock inspection and corrosion measurement”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Dockyard Academy: Deliver a Scale Model” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.explanation: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：把雙程時間當單程會將厚度加倍。 對「背壁回波與塗層影響」，以已知厚度試塊核對聲速和探頭延遲，保留 A 掃描。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
quiz.explanationEn: First examine this alternative cause: Treating round-trip time as one-way doubles thickness. For Backwall echoes and coating effects, Check velocity and probe delay with a known-thickness reference and retain the A-scan. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
